paite: Huai ni chiang in khelhna leh nitna siangsak ding in, David inkote leh Jerusalem a tengte a ding in tuikhuk kihong ahong om ding hi.
heading: Jerusalem Hihsianthouna
english: “In that day there will be a fountain opened to David’s house and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.

paite: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, gam a kipan in milimte minte ka satkhe ding a, theihgige in a-omta kei ding uh; huan zawlneite leh kha nin gam a kipan in ka paikhesak ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: It will come to pass in that day, says Yahweh of Armies, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they will be remembered no more. I will also cause the prophets and the spirit of impurity to pass out of the land.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, zawlnei kuapeuh ahong kilat laileh amah suangtu anu leh apa'n akiang ah, "Na hing kei ding; TOUPA min in zuau na gen a," achi ding ua; amah suangtu anu leh apa'n thu agenkholh ziak in amah asun pailet ding uhi.
english: It will happen that when anyone still prophesies, then his father and his mother who bore him will tell him, ‘You must die, because you speak lies in Yahweh’s name;’ and his father and his mother who bore him will stab him when he prophesies.

paite: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, zawlneite thu agenkholhna uah, amengmuh uah azahlak chiat ding ua; khem ding in samul phan puanak leng asilh sam kei ding uhi.
english: It will happen in that day that the prophets will each be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies; they won’t wear a hairy mantle to deceive,

paite: "Zawlnei ka hi kei, leiletmi ka hi; ka tuailai a kipan a sikha a bawl ka hih khit tak ziak in,” achi zaw ding uhi.
english: but he will say, ‘I am no prophet, I am a tiller of the ground; for I have been made a bondservant from my youth.’

paite: Mi'n akiang ah, na bante kikal a liamnate bang ahia? achi ding ua, huchi in ama'n, "Huaite ka lawmte insung a ka liamnate ahi uh," chi in adawng ding uhi.
english: One will say to him, ‘What are these wounds between your arms?’ Then he will answer, ‘Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.’

paite: "Aw namsau, ka belamchingmi dou ding leh mi ka lawm dou ding in halh in, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Belamchingmi khen in, huan belamte adalh ding uh; huchi in aneute tung ah ka khut ka lik ding hi.
heading: Belamchingtu Khetna
english: “Awake, sword, against my shepherd, and against the man who is close to me,” says Yahweh of Armies. “Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered; and I will turn my hand against the little ones.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, gam tengteng ah, huai a seh nih satkhiak in a-om dia asi ding uhi; himahleh huai a athumna nutsiat in a-om ding, TOUPA'N achi.
english: It shall happen that in all the land,” says Yahweh, “two parts in it will be cut off and die; but the third will be left in it.

paite: Huan aseh thumna mei a paisuak in ka hon tawi dia, dangka hihsiangthou bang in ka hihsiangthou ding a, dangka ettel bang in ka entel ding hi; ka min alou ding ua, amau ka dawng ding; ka mite ahi, ka chi dia, amau, TOUPA ka Pathian ahi," hon chi ding uhi.
english: I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is tested. They will call on my name, and I will hear them. I will say, ‘It is my people;’ and they will say, ‘Yahweh is my God.’”
